## Shared scenes

> During a federal election, Miss Cornelia and Captain Jim discuss political opinions with [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md), celebrating or lamenting the [Liberal](../codex/factions.md#liberal) victory. Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) visits the lighthouse, where she unknowingly snubs a freshly shaved [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md) before having a poignant conversation with Captain Jim about his impending death, his lost love [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), and his wish for [Anne](../character/anne.md) to care for [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS

> Owen and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) confess their love for one another in the garden and seal their commitment. Afterward, they gather with [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Captain Jim, who offers a warm and solemn benediction for their futures before taking his leave. [Susan](../character/susan.md) returns late from the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen), bringing news and expressing her surprise over Miss Cornelia's upcoming marriage.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES

> Miss Cornelia and [Susan](../character/susan.md) share local gossip with [Anne](../character/anne.md) following her return from [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe), detailing the antics of the new [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) minister, Mr. Meredith, and his motherless children. They discuss the messy state of the manse, the children's mischief, and local church politics before Miss Cornelia departs.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP

> Miss Cornelia investigates Mary's past and learns that Mrs. [Wiley](../character/wiley.md) has died, leaving Mary an orphan once more. Meanwhile, the children gather in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) to hear [Walter](../character/walter.md) read myths and share stories. [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md) arrives with the news of Mrs. Wiley's death, startling Mary, while [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) promises to pray that Mary can remain in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds).
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER VIII. MISS CORNELIA INTERVENES

> Miss Cornelia confronts Mr. Meredith about Mary Vance's background, prompting him to have a kind heart-to-heart conversation with Mary. Desperate to prevent Mary from being sent back to the orphan asylum, [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) plucks up the courage to ask Miss Cornelia to adopt her. After consulting her husband [Marshall](../character/marshall.md), Miss Cornelia agrees to take Mary in, and the children celebrate her new home before she leaves the manse.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER IX. UNA INTERVENES

> While their father and [Jerry](../character/jerry.md) are away and [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) is bedridden with an illness, [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) try to manage the household and care for a sick [Carl](../character/carl.md). On Monday, they attempt to clean the house and shake rugs in the adjacent graveyard, inadvertently causing a scandal in the community when neighbors mistake their actions as occurring on Sunday. Despite running low on food and struggling with cooking, their troubles end when [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) recovers, sunshine returns, and the [Blythes](../codex/factions.md#blythes) come back to join them in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley).
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER X. THE MANSE GIRLS CLEAN HOUSE

> [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) complain to [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) about the minister's children singing a lighthearted song in the graveyard during a [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) prayer meeting. After [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) brings the issue to Mr. Meredith's attention, he calls [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), and [Carl](../character/carl.md) into his study to gently reprimand them. Ashamed, the children resolve to punish themselves through their [Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#conduct-club), while Mr. Meredith despairs over his parenting and longs for [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md).
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXVII. A SACRED CONCERT
